description: This Java interface defines a LoraProvider component within the Eclipse Hono project, specifying methods for handling LoRaWAN messages, such as extracting message details, content types, HTTP methods, and sending commands. It outlines the contract for LoRaWAN communication in the connector framework.

classes.name: LoraProvider
classes.description: A Java interface defining the contract for LoRaWAN message providers, including methods for message extraction, content negotiation, and downlink command transmission.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the LoRaWAN provider, used as an identifier in messaging.

methods.name: pathPrefix
methods.description: Returns the URL path prefix associated with this provider.

methods.name: extractMessageType
methods.description: Extracts the message type from an incoming JSON message, defaults to UPLINK.

methods.name: acceptedContentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type that this provider accepts, defaults to JSON.

methods.name: acceptedHttpMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method accepted for incoming data, defaults to POST.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts the device ID from a given JSON message; may throw an exception if extraction fails.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload content from a JSON message; may throw an exception if extraction fails.

methods.name: extractNormalizedData
methods.description: Optional method to extract normalized data as a map from the message.

methods.name: extractAdditionalData
methods.description: Optional method to extract additional, non-normalized data as a JSON object.

methods.name: sendDownlinkCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to a device via the provider, returning a Future indicating success or failure.
